name: Katsuragi Oshihito
source:
A general of the Nanatsu army who leads the beast people.
He has a cold and frank manner of speaking and takes a strict attitude with Chihiro.
He uses a skill called "Hakontou".
He's an old friend of Kazahaya and Hiiragi.

He is technically the first Genbu of Earth of the series.
His particular trait is "Wish".
